lines: The one who saved me from that place where even the faintest hint of light is ssswallowed whole...nestlingsss such as you could never hope to fathom his greatnesss. I was foolish to believe otherwise.
Ever since they arrived, they have more than doubled the pace of the colonization movement. Word has spread that these ruffians have even managed to infiltrate Yorcia Weald's deepest recesses.
If they were to fully awaken, the land would split in twain, choking tendrils dragging pioneers into a bottomless crevasse. No, what you see now is merely a foreshadowing of what is to come.
It was my job, he remarked almost flippantly, to help him see his goals through. I felt tugged in all directions, but he invested in me a fraction of the energies he gathered from Tartarus.
1: Go forth, my knight, and set thy soul ablaze amidst the quenchless flames of Asgarth!
Ahahahahahaha! Splendid, mortal! Thine ardent rage doth please me well!
10: Then let me cut right-aroo to the chase. Loath as I am to alarm-a-dilly you, I must confess-doodley-ess my concern over Doctor Shantotto's recent ding-dang-doodley behavior.
That's well and true as a giggity-goobbue, but this time I can't shake-aroo the feeling that something is a-brew-areeno.
2: In ages past, I oft journeyed the boundless aethyr to pay visit this emerald isle.
4: Honored to stand before you again, Sir Ragelise.
6: What's the big idea, eh!? I paid good gil for that curse! You think you can just up and dispect...despeckle...un-cursify it like that!?
9: The time has come for us to make our meteoric rise. All who oppose will be dealt an ample serving of demise!
Now and forever more, the fire of the Shantotto Empire shall burn bright!
We venture forth to conquer Vana'diel and claim our birthright.
???: I have followed your instructions to the letter. Months upon years have I toiled, seeking guidance from both man and the heavens, never once letting my training or dedication falter.
What are they? Why, the rays of light you just saw, of course. Or what remains of them, at least. Raining down from the heavens, they settled in forests, marshes, and mountains...
It is nothing to be concerned about. When reading someone's memories with my altered...perspective...it occasionally releases images and thoughts sealed deep within the mind.
Why does this new cardinal allow the child to walk freely after the cathedral had taken steps to ensure her eternal confinement? And why bring her here to San d'Oria...?
Abda-Lurabda: Poor old Tateeya is stuck in the factory all by herself! But lucky me gets to go on a field trip with Mister Ghatsad!
Mister Ghatsad was about to tell us about the Alzadaal civilization. These ruins have so many stories!
Are y-you trying to scare me too, Mister Ghatsad? I'm not sure I wanna stay here much longer...
Look at those fish swimming around in there! I wonder what would happen if the windows broke!
Abelard: I'm Abelard, mayor of this village. It's so tiny, you see, that all I do is mediate when there are disagreements.
A pira...entrepreneur associate of mine known as Gilgamesh has had your name on his lips the past several days.
Their activities aren't completely on the up-and-up, but as a port town, we still depend on them.
He rescued a young woman adrift at sea, and she spoke quite highly of you when she woke up.
Abquhbah: I've neglected to bring a very important matter to your attention... My most humble apologies!
Her dedication to the running of this business has been even more pathological than usual...
Well, at least the loss of Duzaf's bounty seems to have blown over without any casualties.
The Windurstian Ambassador is here at the moment, talking business with President Naja...
Ace of Cups: We will be returning to town... After we have silenced you forever!
Ace of Swords: So, Mithra... Tell us where you hid our ruler's belongings! If you do not want to join him in death, then you had best speak the truth!
We have found you, Mithra! Return the lifeforce of our leader back to us!
Ace of Wands: The slumbering strength is our ruler!
Ada: Just because the Windurstians are trying to be friends with the Yagudo doesn't mean we should hold back from continuing our fight with the beastmen.
Go ahead and savage the brutes, I say! If Windurst puts forward an official complaint, I'll handle it for you.
Adelheid: That is, the weakening of the caverns' structural integrity through strategic blasting. This will serve as groundwork for the mission's second and final stage--the grand finale! Oh, glee!
In the unlikely event that you--<gasp!>--fail in your mission, return here and I'll provide you with a replacement.
An operative positioned within will give you a complete briefing. It's bound to be as simple as fractal geometry!
The Republic's effort comprises two stages, and we need you to partake in the first.
Adhemar: Did you not hear the first time? "Traitor," he said! Fools we were to have placed our trust in you...
Adolie: So that's why Captain Wolfgang has been on edge lately... But what is really going on at those crags?
Aissaville: ...So that's why you're seeking signatures. I understand your predicament, and empathize with your cause. My name alone may not count for much, but I offer it without reserve.
Sir Ragelise is a great knight and an even greater man. His courage and valor have earned him the deep respect of the entire San d'Orian army.
A San d'Oria bereft of his inspirational leadership would be utterly unimaginable in these dark times.
Ah, you must be Sir Ragelise's trusted comrade, <player>. How fare you?
Ajido-Marujido: Star Sibyl, the magic the creature was using was no ordinary spellcraft. That power was of the Stars and the Moon. The same power that pulses through the Horutoto Ruins and fills the Mana Orbs...
Ah, finally. Without that ring, I can'taru get into the Minister's Chambers. Not being able to get into my own room is going to do wonders for my reputation as a formidable spell-slinger!
The wounds the Orastery received from the war haven't healed, even after twenty-odd years. The best of the War Warlock mages are dying off, unable to train new, younger replacementarus.
The power of the Stars and the Moon that was stored in their Mana Orbs, the small amountaru of that same energy left in the fountain, and the magic of the Star Sibyl's Diza Star...
Aldo: Tough on everyone but yourself, I see... Very well. It will take some time to prepare the ship. I will send a messenger when everything is ready. Until then, why don't you take a look around the city?
As much as I'd love you to join us here at the Tenshodo, I think I already know your answer to that offer. But if you're ever in the neighborhood, be sure to drop by. You're always welcome.
Well, I think it's time I took that vacation I've been promising myself. You should go someplace quiet and get some rest as well. I have a feeling that the real adventure has just begun...
Deep within the Orc, Quadav, and Yagudo strongholds, there are doors that the beastmen guard with their lives. Beyond those doors lie giant crystals emitting a strange, eerie light.
Alexander: 'Twould be but a small hope, but the only being that could convince Vana'diel to accept her in this time would be one born of Altana's tears.
If thou dost deem her to be of great importance, then I shall honor thy request to give her form in this world once more.
That girl's presence in this world is forbidden, and is why death doth clamor to claim her at every opportunity.
Even Phoenix can only protect her for so long. Its breath draws ever fainter, its energies beginning to wane.
Allaipre: I knew you were up to something, acting all shady like you were! And look at you now! Skipping work and leaving the shop unattended to come to a place like this!
Well, if you don't get back to work, there'll be no dinner tonight! Or any other night for that matter!
So this is what was so important you had to leave the shop? What is this? What's going on here?
Alois: <player>, you are to travel to Rabao and obtain further details on your task from Dancing Wolf. He has already been sent to investigate the location of the salt.
Anyway, it does not matter whether you like it or not. The mission has already been approved by the Senate, and this fine adventurer has already accepted it.
I am thinking only of the well-being of the citizens of the Republic... Furthermore, the budget for this mission has already been approved by the Senate.
Ah, you're finally here. Now let me inform you of your next mission. There is a rare type of salt that can only be found in the Vollbow Region.
Altair: I should never have let my guard down...I was struck from behind, and the next thing I knew, I woke up here. I shudder to think at what would have happened to me if you hadn't come.
What? You were sent on a mission for the embassy...? I see. My apologies...if it weren't for me, you wouldn't have had to come to such a dangerous place.
Don't stress over it. All new diplomatic personnel have to report to the archduke anyway. It's always darkest before the dawn, as they say.
At Delkfutt's Tower, you demonstrated bravery above and beyond the call of duty. That's why I want you to spearhead this mission.
Altiret: I dare you to go down there and ask her name. You think you could handle that?
Amar: W-we're just keeping the tunnel closed to protect you...
Amaura: Very well then, I'll get started. But, just so ye know, this isn't some quack's instant synthesis recipe. Don't forget to breathe from time to time while ye wait!
While it can alleviate the more severe symptoms, and relieve pain by way of dulling the senses, the effects are temporary at best. Ye understand that, don't ye?
Once it has grown to maturity, ye'll find resin seeping out from the crack of ripened fruit. That resin, solidified, is what is needed to make our medicine.
And to think that not a decade ago, the saplings from which the bulbs could be obtained were still as common as those pesky little hares out in Ronfaure...
Ambrotien: The fair Claidie I d'Oraguille has invited you to the chateau. She wishes for you to see the flowers that have bloomed from the seeds you brought back from Altepa.
It's hard to believe Orcs have their hands on such dangerous equipment. More patrols will have to be sent out to prevent any new developments in their evil plans.
Ah, the great angler returns! I was worried, to be honest. All you hear these days is the massing of beasts, the erosion of the Crystal Lines, and now...
It is an honor to be invited to the chateau garden. One day you may even have the opportunity to attend one of their royal garden parties.
Amchuchu: The technology employed dates back to the great war that raged long ago. I remember him showing me a diagram-wiagram of it in his notebook, and the remains of this one match it perfectly.
As I have never seen one in these lands before, I postulataru that Melvien was intimately acquainted with its workings...but this doesn't come as a surprise either, does it?
Ah, yes. The distinguishing characteristic is the fuse. From what I gleaned, it looks as if one can set the time at which the device detonatarus.
All those in the fair city-wity who dropped unconscious, be they of the twelve orders or not, popped right back up like nothing had happened.
Amkeen: These Lamiae have been enhanced through advanced alchemical processes, Grand Vizier.
Amnaf: ...it appears that <player> is entrusted with duties not only within the boundaries of the Empire, but across every region of the Aradjiah Continent.
We regret to inform you that on the evening of the previous day, the Emperor's immortal soul passed out of the realm of Urhguum.
...to chase down souls that flee the realm of the dead...rend them with his terrible jaws, and return them to the underworld...
My most abject apologies, Grand Vizier. We have soldiers combing every ilm of the capital. We will find her.
Andagge: Hmm... The Madder Falcons suffered heavy losses at the Battle of La Theine, and would benefit from every extra sword they can get.
Andrause: Very good. I knew I could count on us being on the same page. Now then, without further ado, I shall explain the task to you. It truly is simple.
You are to investigate a number of creatures dwelling within the Sea Serpent Grotto in my stead.
As promised, I relinquish this to you. Should another be required, you shall find me here.
A fine image this is, but this creature isn't one of my investigation subjects.
Andreine: Indeed there are. Though Adoulin was founded long ago, it was not long enough ago to predate the written word. The books are practically cascading from the shelves, so voluminous are they.
It would not do for some of the information contained within to be seen by common citizens. Therefore, many of those reports are relegated to the stacks for safekeeping.
You wish to learn more about our princess's sword? Would that I could help you further, but if what you seek is not located in our annals, then I am unable to do so.
In summation, it is impossible to provide you with every tome from this ever-growing mass of vellum. I will need a subject via which to select a few relevant texts.
Anilla: It's a country in its own right, no? Quite savage lands for a "country," I must declare! Still, though, word is that they are searching for able-bodied adventurers to serve as pioneers.
The whole affair certainly seems ludicrous enough. Not like it affects us here, though.
Beyond the reaches of the Sea of Zafmlug, toward where the sun sets, lies Adoulin...
Well, if you truly feel they need your aid, I wish you the best of luck.
Anoki: Even under the orders of the cathedral, no airship can be freely commandeered to fly off to any old place in Vana'diel--especially not the Tavnazian Marquisate!
Vessels not registered with the air travel agency are considered illegal, and are only permitted to dock here in emergency situations.
Are you still going on about that imaginary airship? I assure you, every single vessel is strictly monitored by the air travel agency.
If you don't believe me, try asking at any of the other agencies. That is, if you don't mind having people doubt your sanity...
Answald: I wonder who that beautiful young lass is waiting for every day and every night down by the docks...
Aphmau: A long time ago, it was said to have been a base for the Ephramadian corsairs, who would terrorize merchant vessels sailing the neighboring waters.
The legendary savior who will be reborn in the body of the iron giant in the hour of the Empire's greatest need...
But...but... Just because they're ghosts now, doesn't mean they don't remember their families and friends, right?
Whenever an important matter arises, you treat me like a child. I'm supposed to listen to whatever you decide.
Apururu: And when you do find him, if...if he really is alive, I have some questions I want you to ask him. Why did the Cardians rise up against him? Who is this Cardian they have chosen for a king?
But I'm glad nothing disastrously bad happened... Lately some of the people who have volunteered for this mission have been attacked by feral Cardians at the exit of the Horutoto Ruins!
...Yes, I believe it can. If the mana orbs within the Cardians are struck with a strong enough blasty-wast of the Stars and the Moon, their motive systems will be disruptarued.
The rings carry-warried by the ministers are such items. Every time a minister is appointed, a ring is made and presented to the new minister by Heavens Tower.
Aquila: I won't be bringing any stray kittens back with me, if that's what you're thinking. The felines have been tended to, as you ordered.
Sorry, sorry. I had a few unanticipated problems fall plop into my lap, but everything's sorted now. I'll be reporting back soon.
I must say, you two are a curious pair. What is it that you hope to gain, taking the crazed mewlings of those cats to heart?
So there are others beside ourselves? I knew there had to be a reason why things weren't proceeding so smoothly...
Aramaviont: When I was in the Northlands, I didn't know if I would ever be back here, sipping tea in the comforts of my quarters. I raise my glass to my colleagues who were not as fortunate...
I never knew His Highness felt that way about the Kingdom... To put the stability of the country ahead of bloodlines and tradition...the royaulais is truly a great leader.
It's now time to show those Orcs the true force of the Royal Knights. The battle will go down in history as the day we put an end to their fiendish plots!
There's not a knight in San d'Oria that doesn't wish to take Lightbringer in his hands. However, there are still many mysteries that surround it...
Arciela: I've discovered that there are references to the Cimmerian Adherents...the followers of Hades. Their coming in past ages was accompanied by toxic miasmas, blades of wind, and the sullying of the land.
It started out with a breeze, with leaves fluttering gently, but slowly you started pushing us forward, helping us to walk step-by-step toward the herculean tasks that lay before us.
In a word, yes. I had been lost in thought in the library, when he gave me a kind word and an encouraging nod. Ever since then, he's always been there to listen to my troubles.
Or is it just as you said? Has his illness progressed to the point where we can't even telepathically communicate with him...and he's become a leafkin in more than just flesh?
Argus: You must go to the Zeruhn Mines in the western section of the Mines District. Once there, you are to collect a report from the overseer.
You can consult the "Mission" section of the main menu to review your objectives. Speed and efficiency are your priorities. Dismissed.
You cannot undertake two missions at the same time. Finish the one you are on now before asking for a new one.
I am in charge of assigning missions to Bastokers who wish to serve their country. Are you one of them?
Arnau: That is quite odd... Not but a few moments ago, another came asking the same questions. I believe her name was Ulmia. Be she an acquaintance of yours?
And it is during that search we realized that the only path to soothing the Twilight God's wrath is to eschew all desire and embrace Altana.
I see. Ulmia, too, wished to learn more of the Gate of the Gods, so I recommended that she attend the upcoming sermon on the subject.
Have you lost your way on the path of life? Come, listen to our sermon. Let us be your guide to the light of Paradise.
Arsha: Please proceed into the audience chamber.
Arzizah: This gate leads to the Imperial Ward. You may only enter by the grace of Her Magnificence, the Empress, or if you have Al Zahbi citizenship.
The Imperial Ward lies on the other side of this wall. Watch your tongue in there, mercenary.
Atori-Tutori: Of course, one never knows. Work your buttaru off for the next few centuries or so, and you just might have the faintest chance of maybe, possibly (if ever improbably) giving me a run for my gil.
Great balls of Firaga! If it isn't Putori-Tutori! Justaru when I was wondering where you might be hiding, lo and behold, you've gone and joined the Hydra Corps!
You still haven't realized? The Atori-Tutori you defeated was merely a part of me. Specifically-wifically speaking, my shadow.
But hey, you got your training, and I got my first decent workout in years. Everybody wins, rightaru?
Aubejart: I apologize, Your Highness. I have not seen the man you seek.
Audibert: My guess is that they are the initials of the individuals who lead orders in opposition to the colonization movement.
How about you blame yourself for failing to come up with any of your own ideas?
Augevinne: One of the "injured" soldiers has gone missing! Well, don't just stand there! Help us search!
Aurfet: I suppose you fancy yourself well-versed in all things to do with the San d'Orian army. All right, let's do it this way. You answer a few questions, and I'll give you what you seek.
Any fool off the street knows the Kingdom's three knightly orders: the Royal Knights, the Temple Knights, and the Royal Guards.
Next question. As you know, the Kingdom is served by a great many regiments of knights. Which of the following does not exist?
Very good. You've demonstrated satisfactory knowledge of the Kingdom's forces. Wait right here. I shall return presently.
Awoken Vampyr Jarl: If you value this one's blood...her very life force...
You will hand the Olduum staff over to me.
Would you prefer we take the Tarutaru instead?
The staff! Without it, our mission is ruined!
Ayame: Travel to Norg and meet with their leader, Gilgamesh. He will give you further information on what you are to do. I will rendezvous with you in Norg when I have finished my current assignment.
Compared to Windurst and San d'Oria, Bastok's relations with Norg run much deeper. That is why, for the sake of our republic's commerce, we are sending adventurers to such a remote location.
Thank you for the compliment. Mythril Musketeers are supposed to be reliable, but I wasn't sure if I could fit the role. Well, at least I do a little bit more than Naji.
While there are many truths that can be seen while within the boundaries of a nation, there are some things that can only be viewed once one has left their native soil.
Babenn: Lord Raogrimm... We've found the Quadav temple in the mines, as you suspected. I-I could not stop them.
Bacherume: But if this letter is truly meant for Monarlais Halver as you say, then we must see that he receives it....
Ahahaha! A sage, you say? They write in characters that we simple folk cannot decipher...
Ahahaha! A member of the royal family would never have such abominable penmanship!
Ahahaha! Well, we must do the mercenary's bidding now, mustn't we?
Bahamut: However, the actions you have chosen to take are useless. While you are fully aware that the children of Altana are powerless against Emptiness, you still drag them into your games.
That child came to me, in search of my assistance. And thus we made a pact--an agreement that was to be put into motion the day the Keeper of the Apocalypse returned to Vana'diel.
Selh'teus proved that to us ten thousand years ago. Destruction is your destiny. You cannot escape what has already been decided.
It does not matter, for now the power within the final crystal--the crystal that holds Al'Taieu in balance--has begun to fade.
Bakool Ja: Created, are these automatons. To search the ruins, why do they continue?
Baraka: You're here with business from the administration, correct? You should probably talk to Consul Helaku.
Barnabas: If I may be so bold, a key gone missing from the vault isn't something you'd overlook, sir. Unless there were other reasons for you not pursuing the matter...?
Truth is, we of the Ducal Guard have been grudgingly biting our tongues all this time, suppressing the burning desire to keep on fighting.
I understand you've suffered much on Jeuno's behalf, and wish to express my regret for the way things had to turn out.
The continued existence of Jeuno is at stake. We, the Ducal Guard, humbly beseech your help in our darkest hour.
Bartholomaus: A brilliantly concocted strategy...is what I would say had we sufficient troops to execute it.
Why, Sir Ragelise! I had been under the impression you were partaking in the diversion.
First and Third Divisions, provide support by eliminating any hostiles encountered!
You heard the lady! It's time for the Republic to enter the fray!
Bastingart: These three tricks will spin the wheel of fortune in your favor, but it is precisely because of their immense powers that we must limit their use to once per game.
Either you or your opponent may choose to "shoot" and roll the dice, "stay" and do nothing, or pick from three tricks up your sleeve.
Boom or Bust is a dice game in which each player competes to get their dice closer to eleven than the other.
Make sure you attempt to turn the tables at the right time, or Lady Luck will be the one cleaning house.
Bataumnalle: Enough of this prattling. We are not here for fun and games. If preparations have been made, then I suggest we move out.
Behsa Alehgo: Sailors and captains of our fair city have a custom of honorrring the morning sun, and as such many of our vessels contain the word "dawn" in their names.
However, we have contacted the scouts to gather intelligence. I suggest that you first head to the fountain to begin your search.
Our research suggests that the "stone wall touched by the light of dawn" has something to do with Adoulin's porrrt district.
Unforrrtunately we are at a loss as to where the "wings of a weather vane that has stood the test of time" might be.
Bellue: I never thought I'd live to hear that melody again. Brings back memories, it does...
Blamor: Heh, Quadav aren't good enough to live in there! One blast should take care of them...
Bonarpant: You still haven't found the girl you're looking for?
Boytz: He does kind of remind me of Sir Raogrimm...
Brakobrik: I have tried...to tell them...that fighting...with people...is no good...like Jabbos said.
Jabbos, you entering the great crystal. We knowing you going to place of Promathia.
Take this...in thanks. It should...be worth...much...above ground.
Brandolf: Sir Nag'molada called the Ducal Guard to assembly and put forth these sentiments, with Archduke Kam'lanaut himself in audience. That is how the decision to surrender was made known to us.
That it is both duty and honor to give one's life to protect our nation and all its citizens is the common conviction held sacred by all those in the Ducal Guard.
Hear me well! Our brothers and sisters in the alliance fight beside us! Fight well, and shame not the proud name of Jeuno's Ducal Guard!
We must have patience, for the time will come again when the children of Altana will arise and reclaim what is rightfully ours.
Brenna: Oh, I truly hope you are! How incredibly grand it would be to see our daring and capable frontiersmen swell in rank! I can barely contain myself thinking about adding an extra member to our cause!
Does that also mean you're one of those pioneers helping to colonize our continent?
Brenton: I find it best not to trouble my ol' noggin too much about particulars. Try living by the mantra of "Be it gem or phlegm, just take 'em!" when you're in the field, and everything should work out fine.
I guess I'll just have to be content with standing behind this here counter and informing true pioneers about all the tricks of the trade. I swear that's the only thing I'll ever do around here.
This should go without saying, but let me spell it out for all those bastards thinking about duping our kindly coalitions. Absolutely no work can be given to those who do not have an imprimatur.
Well, there you have it. When the powers of these six coalitions combine, they captain each and every pioneer towards colonization success! Hopefully you'll find the one that's right for you.
Cait Sith: The besiegers were quickly overwhelmed by those they had sought to smite, and were dealt a sound thrashing at the hands of the Shadow Lord. Nigh obliterated. Not dissimilar to the current situation.
I am limited in the manner of aid I can lend you in this dark hour. Not fully at liberty to assist. The responsibility to save the world from peril ultimately falls upon the Champions of the Dawn.
Give no credit to the notion that your lives and memories are make-believe. You mustn't allow your resolve to waver, for that's exactly what the enemy desires! The weakness they seek to exploit!
Unless we take preventative measures--and with due haste--Atomos will continue to devour the brighter future without abandon, until nothing remains. Picked clean to the last memory orb.
Cait Sith Aon: We mustn't forget that we are all for one. Our cooperation is required to see our plan to fruition. For the plan to bear fruit.
The project's successful completion takes precedence over our individual survival. Our very lives.
The mission's fulfillment, none need be reminded, is our utmost priority. Must stay the course.
Cait Sith Ceithir: Listen to me, Naoi. Step back and take in a full view of the playing board, and you'll realize the poor position your side is in. Between a rock and a hard place. It's plain to see who will prevail!
And who've you got there with you, hmmm? What the cat's dragged in? A ragtag band of second-rate adventurers--oh, I'm sorry, I meant to say the Champions of the Dawn! Nyahahaha!
Have you looked up at the sky recently? Tilted back your head? The comet that draws ever near--whose advance will be stayed by none...
Nyahahaha! Hate to disappoint, but I can't allow you to simply walk away. Tootle along. Lilith has use for that one, she says.
Cait Sith Coig: A common cat, you say? Such impudence! In what capacity could one possibly mistake our regal stock for that of a mundane feline!? A common cat!?
I'm of the same opinion. Make scratching posts out of them, I say. A little stress relief.
Ah, I understand now! Finally clear! The insolent young slip of a girl Naoi mentioned!
Naoi, Naoi! This is certainly no time to be idly singing prophecies. No time at all!
Cait Sith Dha: I've a thought. Tell them, we should, of the thing that can be got from the lake yonder, and then move on. Be on our merry way.
Unsure, I am. All this talk of...Champions, was it? Sounds a bit off to me. Not too right.
Can she be trusted? Her words hold truth? Could they be...the Champions of the Dawn?
Cait Sith Naoi: Oh well, so sorry to have bothered. Most important is that we stay the course at hand. Our hands on course. Our work here will not be compromised. No compromises.
Indeed? Indeed? Then I shall see to keeping an eye on her and her underling. A careful cait's eye. I leave our endeavors elsewhere up to the rest of you.
Ah, yes, an unusual name. Should this Ragelise be a playing piece on our side of the board, it would be a shame not to exploit him. A wasted resource.
Yes, yes, save the knowledge for a rainy day. We tell the girl where it can be obtained, and the rest is entirely up to her. Her entirely. And, oh...?
Cait Sith Ochd: You have no idea! I nearly had my tail ripped off at the base. Traumatic to say the least. Terribly traumatic.
Cait Sith Seachd: Naoi! Do you read me, Naoi? I've stumbled upon a conspicuous cave opening not a stone's throw away from where we passed by earlier.
Now, now, Coig. Violence is the first resort of the incompetent. No harm in hearing them out. Let them have a say.
It's as Coig has just told us. Just informed us. How is it those two have come to be here?
Silly, silly Naoi! You've gone and forgotten to vote! Didn't raise your hand!
Cait Sith Sia: If nobody minds, I'll wait here a while longer for the others. Wait and see.
Cait Sith Tri: Aon and Ochd's brushes with danger are quite the cause for concern. Quite the cause. Now, of all times, we cannot afford to be careless.
And what say you, Ceithir? Are we to think that they simply passed through Atomos? Right on through?
Then there is indeed someone attempting to impede our work? To slow us down?
Have we not all overlooked a terribly important issue? Quite forgotten.
Carbuncle: If the siphoning of energy continues, the boundaries of the crystal world they protect will shatter, and their true forms will manifest upon this world of Vana'diel.
<player>. Venture deep within the ruins and open Carbuncle's gate. With the knowledge you now hold, you should be able to operate the device that lies within.
He who tries to save the world and he who tries to save mankind... Bahamut and Diabolos would also surely oppose me if they knew of my plans.
No matter how tightly sealed, as long as it exists alongside the mothercrystal, Promathia's will shall one day awaken.
Carey: Ah... Um... If you are looking for Cid, he should be in his laboratory in the Metalworks...
